name: com.larje.spritemapsgenerator
description: Editor tool that generates normal and mask maps for 2D sprites and Spine atlas pages: procedural maps (bevel + detail) and AI normal maps (Marigold via a local Python environment), blended per texture with a slider. Open via Tools > Sprite Maps Generator. With com.unity.ai.assistant installed, generation is also exposed to AI agents as SpriteMaps_* MCP tools.
